narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixty four is four cubed and eight squared. That means every cube is a square.
<bookmark mark='eight'/>Eight is two cubed. But two squared is four and three squared is nine, so eight is not a square.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>One case that fails is enough to break the word always.
